platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Connect and configure destinations for the streaming tree.

planned.credentials: Stream keys stored in the OS credential store, never in the browser
planned.encoding: Per-branch encoding profile (bitrate, resolution, keyframe interval)

streams.title: Streams
streams.description: Live control of the ingest and of every outgoing branch.

planned.ingest: MediaMTX ingest state and OBS connection details
planned.processControl: Start/stop of individual FFmpeg processes per branch
planned.metrics: Live bitrate, dropped frames and reconnect counters
planned.restartPolicy: Automatic restart policy for a failed branch

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Stream metadata presets shared across platforms.

planned.presets: Reusable presets applied to several platforms at once
planned.overrides: Per-platform overrides driven by the capability model
planned.push: Pushing metadata to platform APIs before going live
planned.history: History of previously used titles and categories

planned.ingest: Local ingest configuration (RTMP port, path, authentication)
planned.binaries: Paths to the MediaMTX and FFmpeg binaries
planned.backendAddress: Backend address, for the future remote-router deployment

language.heading: Interface language
language.description: Applies immediately and is remembered in this browser.
language.note: Only the language preference is stored locally. Stream keys, tokens and metadata are never kept in the browser.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Event Bus status and Twitch inbound connectors - a diagnostic and operational view, not the finished operator chat or OBS overlay.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Diagnostics from the router and from every branch.

planned.backendLogs: Structured backend logs streamed over SSE or WebSocket
planned.ffmpegOutput: Per-branch FFmpeg output with severity filtering
planned.diagnosticBundle: Export of a diagnostic bundle with secrets stripped

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.message: The page you were looking for is not part of the application.
